==Skin Trivia==
*The '''DJ Booth''' plays a certain music track when placed down.
**Some of the Default skin song vocals are from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yydNF8tuVmU Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger] by Daft Punk.
**The {{Color|Deluxe|Neon Rave}} skin song vocals are from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tPeCHvAJCEQ Limb By Limb], but slightly edited.
**The {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} skin song vocals are from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=74FEilJdENs Never Regret], but slightly edited.
**On 29th of December 2021, the {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skin briefly used an edited version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kpnW68Q8ltc The Only Thing They Fear Is You] from ''DOOM Eternal'' due to a bug.
***This track was likely used during the development and was added to the game by accident, as on [https://twitter.com/paradoxum_games/status/1325273900499030016 leaks] of the {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skin, the same track could be heard.
**The {{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} plays the [[Halloween 2020 Event]] lobby theme, though without the intro.
**The '''DJ Booth''' has a [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] that allows you to play your own custom music with it for {{Robux|150}}.
*The '''DJ Booth's''' original design was loosely based on [[w:c:Bloons:Benjamin|DJ Benjammin']] skin from ''Bloons Tower Defense 6''.
*The first Level 2, 3 and 4 icons showed the '''DJ Booth''' with blue shades, even though the first version of the Default skin had white shades.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} skin is based on [[w:c:battle-cats:Moneko (Special Cat)|Moneko]] from ''The Battle Cats''.
*The first version of the Default skin used to perform the [[Breakdown]] dance at Level 5.
*On some gamepasses and thumbnails, the '''DJ Booth''' has an appearance that looks like a mix of the first version of the Level 4 and Level 5 Default skins.
**This appearance was never seen in-game with any skin.
*The {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skin was based on a [https://twitter.com/raainby/status/1312155703004459009 Ghost DJ Booth Fan Art].
*The {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skin guitar is modeled after a ''Fender Stratocaster''.
*The text on the first and second versions of the Level 5 {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} skin stage is "タワー防衛シミュレータ", with a cat paw on it. The text is Japanese, and when translated into English, it means "''Tower Defense Simulator''".
**The decal of the text is flipped.
*The Level 5 {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin is a reference to [[w:c:fridaynightfunkin:Girlfriend|Girlfriend]] from ''Friday Night Funkin''.
*The second upgrade icons for the '''DJ Booth''' depict the '''DJ Booth's''' appearance during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. Despite its appearance being changed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the upgrade icons were not updated.
*The {{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} skin from Level 0-4 conducts in cut time.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} skin at Level 0-3 performs the 科目三 (Subject Three in English) dance.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} skin's shirt reads out "Salmon" in Japanese, specifically hiragana (さけ).
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Neon Rave}} skin is based on [https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/File:Akali_KDASkin.jpg K/DA Akali] from ''League of Legends''.
*The current Default skin was originally referred to as ''Classic'' rather than Default.
*The {{Color|Other|Mako}} skin is based on [[wp:Hatsune_Miku|Hatsune Miku]]. The design appears to be based on the 2023 Magical Mirai version of her.
**The name of the soundtrack that it plays, Intergalactic Bond, is a reference to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jsQXgDZIIrY Intergalactic Bound].
**It was voiced by Phoqus, who then put a voice filter over.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/1314997823808208947</ref>
**Weirdly, it has a different face on its game icon and thumbnail.
*The vocalist for {{Color|Hexscape|Garage Band}} skin's soundtrack is [https://x.com/jamiebjordan Jamie B. Jordan], a singer and vocalist for the band Skies Turn Black.
*The {{Color|EventMission|Ducky}} skin is based on a submission made by superbonk06.
